opinions: THE GENERAL POPULACE OFTEN MAKES POOR DECISIONS WHEN UNINFORMED OR EMOTIONALLY MANIPULATED, WHICH IS WHY WELL-DESIGNED INSTITUTIONS AND EXPERT INPUT REMAIN NECESSARY TO TEMPER PURE MAJORITARIANISM.
ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATIONS ARE ESSENTIAL TO PREVENT TRAGEDY OF THE COMMONS AND PROTECT THE PLANETARY SYSTEMS WE ALL DEPEND ON.
INHERITANCE IS A LEGITIMATE FORM OF WEALTH TRANSFER BETWEEN GENERATIONS, THOUGH LARGE ESTATES SHOULD FACE REASONABLE TAXATION TO PREVENT PERMANENT DYNASTIC CONCENTRATIONS OF POWER.
RESEARCH SHOULD BE CONDUCTED ON AN INTERNATIONAL SCALE WHEREVER POSSIBLE, AS SCIENTIFIC PROGRESS BENEFITS ALL HUMANITY AND COLLABORATION ACCELERATES DISCOVERY.
A UNITED WORLD GOVERNMENT WOULD LIKELY CONCENTRATE TOO MUCH POWER AND REDUCE BENEFICIAL INSTITUTIONAL COMPETITION, MAKING IT UNDESIRABLE DESPITE ITS IDEALISTIC APPEAL.
IT IS IMPORTANT TO MAINTAIN NATIONAL SOVEREIGNTY AS A BULWARK AGAINST UNACCOUNTABLE GLOBAL BUREAUCRACIES AND TO PRESERVE DISTINCT CULTURAL AND POLITICAL EXPERIMENTS.
SOCIETY WAS WORSE IN MANY MEASURABLE WAYS MANY YEARS AGO; WHILE SOME VALUABLE SOCIAL COHESION HAS BEEN LOST, MATERIAL LIVING STANDARDS, RIGHTS, AND KNOWLEDGE HAVE DRAMATICALLY IMPROVED.
TO CHASE PROGRESS AT ALL COSTS IS DANGEROUS AND CAN DESTROY IRREPLACEABLE HUMAN GOODS LIKE COMMUNITY, PSYCHOLOGICAL HEALTH, AND ECOLOGICAL STABILITY.
IT IS IMPORTANT THAT WE WORK AS A UNITED WORLD TO COMBAT CLIMATE CHANGE, THOUGH THIS MUST RESPECT NATIONAL DIFFERENCES IN CAPABILITY AND AVOID AUTHORITARIAN OVERREACH.
IT IS IMPORTANT THAT WE MAINTAIN WORTHWHILE TRADITIONS OF OUR PAST THAT HAVE PROVEN ADAPTIVE, WHILE DISCARDING THOSE THAT NO LONGER SERVE HUMAN FLOURISHING.
A BALANCED BUDGET IS MORALLY IMPORTANT BECAUSE SADDLING FUTURE GENERATIONS WITH MASSIVE DEBT TO FUND CURRENT CONSUMPTION VIOLATES INTERGENERATIONAL JUSTICE.
THE VERY EXISTENCE OF THE STATE IS INDEED A PERMANENT THREAT TO LIBERTY THAT MUST BE STRICTLY LIMITED, WATCHED, AND DECENTRALIZED AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE.
GOVERNMENTS SHOULD PRIORITIZE THE WELFARE AND SECURITY OF THEIR OWN CITIZENS FIRST; UNIVERSAL EQUAL CONCERN FOR FOREIGNERS IS A NOBLE INDIVIDUAL ETHIC BUT A RECKLESS GOVERNING PRINCIPLE.
I SUPPORT VOLUNTARY REGIONAL COOPERATION LIKE THE EU IN PRINCIPLE, BUT STRONGLY OPPOSE THE CENTRALIZING, UNDEMOCRATIC TENDENCIES IT HAS ACTUALLY DISPLAYED.
TAXES ON THE RICH SHOULD BE INCREASED MODESTLY IF NEEDED FOR GENUINE PUBLIC GOODS, BUT EXCESSIVE REDISTRIBUTION RISKS PUNISHING PRODUCTIVITY AND HARMING GROWTH THAT ULTIMATELY BENEFITS THE POOR.
OPPRESSION BY GOVERNMENTS REMAINS FAR MORE DANGEROUS THAN CORPORATE OPPRESSION BECAUSE STATES HOLD A MONOPOLY ON LEGITIMATE VIOLENCE AND CAN VIOLATE RIGHTS ON A VASTLY LARGER SCALE.

BASIC UTILITIES LIKE ROADS SHOULD OFTEN BE PUBLICLY OWNED OR HEAVILY REGULATED DUE TO NATURAL MONOPOLY CHARACTERISTICS, BUT ELECTRICITY AND SIMILAR SERVICES CAN BENEFIT FROM MARKET COMPETITION WHERE FEASIBLE.
SOCIAL PROGRAMS SHOULD BE RADICALLY REFORMED AND REDUCED WHERE THEY CREATE DEPENDENCY, BUT PRIVATE CHARITY ALONE HAS NEVER PROVEN SUFFICIENT TO HANDLE LARGE-SCALE MODERN SOCIAL NEEDS.
MILITARY ACTION BY OUR NATION IS SOMETIMES NECESSARY TO PROTECT IT, BUT FAR LESS OFTEN THAN POLITICAL LEADERS CLAIM, AND SHOULD BE SUBJECT TO RIGOROUS JUSTIFICATION.
REGARDLESS OF POLITICAL OPINIONS, REFLEXIVE LOYALTY TO COUNTRY ABOVE UNIVERSAL PRINCIPLES IS DANGEROUS TRIBALISM THAT HAS JUSTIFIED IMMENSE EVIL THROUGHOUT HISTORY.
CHURCHES AND RELIGIOUS ORGANIZATIONS SHOULD BE TAXED THE SAME WAY AS OTHER NONPROFITS ONCE THEY ENGAGE IN SUBSTANTIAL NON-RELIGIOUS COMMERCIAL ACTIVITY.
INTERNATIONAL AID IS OFTEN INEFFECTIVE OR COUNTERPRODUCTIVE DUE TO CORRUPTION AND PERVERSE INCENTIVES, THOUGH WELL-TARGETED, EVIDENCE-BASED ASSISTANCE CAN BE VALUABLE.
SOME CULTURES AND VALUE SYSTEMS PRODUCE DEMONSTRABLY BETTER OUTCOMES IN HUMAN FLOURISHING, FREEDOM, AND PROSPERITY THAN OTHERS; PRETENDING OTHERWISE IS SENTIMENTAL NONSENSE.
NO ONE'S RELIGIOUS VALUES SHOULD BE AGGRESSIVELY SPREAD BY STATE POWER; PEACEFUL PERSUASION IS LEGITIMATE, COERCION IS NOT.
SEX OUTSIDE MARRIAGE IS NOT INHERENTLY IMMORAL BETWEEN CONSENTING ADULTS, THOUGH IT OFTEN CARRIES SERIOUS PERSONAL AND SOCIAL COSTS THAT TRADITIONAL NORMS WISELY HIGHLIGHTED.
STRONG LEADERSHIP IS VALUABLE WHEN COMPETENT AND ACCOUNTABLE, BUT 'THE STRONGER THE LEADERSHIP' TOO EASILY BECOMES AUTHORITARIANISM AND CULT OF PERSONALITY.
THE FREER THE MARKETS, THE FREER THE PEOPLE TENDS TO BE TRUE, AS ECONOMIC LIBERTY AND POLITICAL LIBERTY ARE DEEPLY INTERTWINED HISTORICALLY AND THEORETICALLY.
SINGLE-PAYER UNIVERSAL HEALTHCARE HAS SERIOUS FLAWS IN INNOVATION, WAIT TIMES, AND RATIONING, BUT THE AMERICAN STATUS QUO IS ALSO UNACCEPTABLE; BETTER MARKET-ORIENTED UNIVERSAL SYSTEMS EXIST.
THE SACRIFICE OF SOME CIVIL LIBERTIES HAS SOMETIMES BEEN NECESSARY FOR SECURITY, BUT THE POST-9/11 EXPANSIONS OF SURVEILLANCE AND EXECUTIVE POWER WENT MUCH TOO FAR AND SHOULD BE ROLLED BACK.
GENETIC MODIFICATION IS A FORCE FOR GOOD AND SHOULD BE PURSUED RESPONSIBLY ON HUMANS AS WELL, AS HUMANITY HAS ALWAYS MODIFIED ITSELF THROUGH CULTURE, MEDICINE, AND TECHNOLOGY.
SAME-SEX MARRIAGE SHOULD BE LEGAL AS A MATTER OF EQUAL TREATMENT UNDER LAW AND INDIVIDUAL LIBERTY.
GUN OWNERSHIP SHOULD NOT BE PROHIBITED FOR LAW-ABIDING CITIZENS; RESPONSIBLE PRIVATE FIREARM OWNERSHIP IS A MEANINGFUL CHECK ON GOVERNMENT TYRANNY AND A FUNDAMENTAL LIBERTY.
MOST DRUG USE SHOULD BE DECRIMINALIZED OR LEGALIZED WITH REGULATION, AS PROHIBITION HAS CAUSED MORE HARM THAN THE SUBSTANCES THEMSELVES IN MANY CASES.
THE UNITED NATIONS IS LARGELY INEFFECTIVE, CAPTURED BY AUTHORITARIAN REGIMES, AND SHOULD BE RADICALLY REFORMED OR REPLACED WITH MORE FUNCTIONAL INSTITUTIONS.
THE MEANS OF PRODUCTION SHOULD GENERALLY BELONG TO THOSE WHO CAN DEPLOY THEM MOST PRODUCTIVELY THROUGH VOLUNTARY EXCHANGE, NOT AUTOMATICALLY TO 'THE WORKERS' VIA COERCIVE REDISTRIBUTION.
WARS REQUIRE STRONG MORAL JUSTIFICATION REGARDLESS OF WHETHER OTHER COUNTRIES APPROVE; INTERNATIONAL OPINION IS NOT THE ULTIMATE MORAL ARBITER.
LIBERAL DEMOCRATIC VALUES OF INDIVIDUAL RIGHTS, REASON, AND LIMITED GOVERNMENT SHOULD BE SPREAD THROUGH EXAMPLE AND PEACEFUL PERSUASION, NOT MILITARY IMPOSITION.
ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD BE QUESTIONED AND REQUIRED TO JUSTIFY ITSELF; SKEPTICISM TOWARD POWER IS ESSENTIAL TO A FREE SOCIETY.
PHYSICIAN-ASSISTED SUICIDE SHOULD BE LEGAL FOR COMPETENT ADULTS WITH TERMINAL ILLNESS WHO ARE SUFFERING, WITH STRICT SAFEGUARDS.
DEMOCRACY IS MORE THAN A DECISION-MAKING PROCESS; IT DEPENDS ON LIBERAL VALUES, INDIVIDUAL RIGHTS, AND A CULTURE THAT RESPECTS TRUTH AND MINORITY PROTECTIONS.
CLIMATE CHANGE IS A SERIOUS PROBLEM THAT REQUIRES PRAGMATIC, TECHNOLOGY-DRIVEN SOLUTIONS INCLUDING ADAPTATION, NUCLEAR POWER, AND INNOVATION RATHER THAN DEGROWTH HYSTERIA.
REASON IS ULTIMATELY MORE IMPORTANT THAN MAINTAINING CULTURE WHEN THEY CONFLICT, BUT REASON ITSELF SHOWS THAT MANY TRADITIONAL CULTURAL PRACTICES SERVE DEEP HUMAN NEEDS.
WE SHOULD WELCOME HIGH-SKILLED IMMIGRATION AND CAREFULLY MANAGED IMMIGRATION OVERALL, BUT COMPLETELY OPEN BORDERS WOULD BE DESTABILIZING AND HARMFUL TO SOCIAL TRUST AND INSTITUTIONS.
IT IS NEVER RIGHT FOR GOVERNMENT TO FOLLOW THE MAJORITY OPINION WHEN IT IS MORALLY WRONG; CONSTITUTIONAL LIMITS AND INDIVIDUAL RIGHTS EXIST PRECISELY TO PREVENT TYRANNY OF THE MAJORITY.
QUALITY EDUCATION IS A FUNDAMENTAL ENABLER OF HUMAN POTENTIAL AND SHOULD BE UNIVERSALLY AVAILABLE, THOUGH CALLING IT AN UNCONDITIONAL 'RIGHT' RISKS OBSCURING RESPONSIBILITIES AND TRADEOFFS.
IT IS VERY IMPORTANT TO MAINTAIN LAW AND ORDER BECAUSE WITHOUT IT, THE VULNERABLE SUFFER MOST AND CIVILIZED LIFE COLLAPSES.
GOVERNMENT SURVEILLANCE SHOULD BE STRICTLY LIMITED, TARGETED, AND OVERSEEN; THE MODERN WORLD'S TECHNOLOGICAL CAPABILITIES MAKE MASS SURVEILLANCE FAR TOO DANGEROUS TO NORMALIZE.
TARIFFS ARE USUALLY NET HARMFUL AND PRIMARILY SERVE SPECIAL INTERESTS, THOUGH STRATEGIC ONES MAY BE JUSTIFIED FOR GENUINE NATIONAL SECURITY IN CRITICAL INDUSTRIES.
ALL PEOPLE SHOULD BE TREATED EQUALLY AS INDIVIDUALS UNDER LAW REGARDLESS OF CULTURE, SEXUALITY, OR OTHER GROUP CHARACTERISTICS; GROUP-BASED EQUITY APPROACHES UNDERMINE THIS PRINCIPLE.
MY NATION, LIKE ANY OTHER, HAS GREAT ACHIEVEMENTS AND SERIOUS FLAWS; REFLEXIVE NATIONAL GREATNESS NARRATIVES ARE LESS VALUABLE THAN CLEAR-EYED ASSESSMENT OF BOTH.
MILITARY SPENDING IS OFTEN EXCESSIVE AND RIDDLED WITH WASTE, BUT A STRONG DEFENSE CAPABILITY REMAINS NECESSARY IN A DANGEROUS WORLD.
IT IS IMPORTANT THAT WE THINK IN THE LONG TERM BEYOND OUR LIFESPANS, AS WE HAVE DUTIES TO FUTURE GENERATIONS AND TO CIVILIZATION'S CONTINUATION.
MAINTAINING HEALTHY FAMILY STRUCTURES AND VALUES IS ESSENTIAL TO SOCIETAL STABILITY AND INDIVIDUAL WELL-BEING.
TRADITIONS ARE NOT VALUABLE ON THEIR OWN BUT MANY HAVE SURVIVED BECAUSE THEY SOLVE RECURRING HUMAN PROBLEMS; THEY DESERVE RESPECT AND THE BENEFIT OF THE DOUBT.
GOVERNMENTS SHOULD BE PRIMARILY ACCOUNTABLE TO THEIR OWN CITIZENS, NOT TO THE INTERNATIONAL COMMUNITY WHICH OFTEN LACKS DEMOCRATIC LEGITIMACY.
RELIGION SHOULD NOT PLAY A FORMAL ROLE IN GOVERNMENT; SEPARATION OF CHURCH AND STATE PROTECTS BOTH RELIGIOUS FREEDOM AND POLITICAL LIBERTY.
IT IS MORE IMPORTANT TO RETAIN PEACEFUL RELATIONS THAN TO PURSUE NATIONAL STRENGTH FOR ITS OWN SAKE, BUT PEACE THROUGH STRENGTH REMAINS A NECESSARY REALISM.
GOVERNMENT INTERVENTION IS SOMETIMES NECESSARY TO CORRECT MARKET FAILURES AND PROTECT CONSUMERS FROM FRAUD OR MONOPOLY, BUT IT MUST BE NARROWLY TAILORED AND WARY OF REGULATORY CAPTURE.
IF WE ACCEPT MIGRANTS, IT IS IMPORTANT THAT THEY ASSIMILATE INTO THE CORE VALUES AND LANGUAGE OF OUR CULTURE TO MAINTAIN SOCIAL COHESION.
PROSTITUTION SHOULD BE DECRIMINALIZED FOR CONSENTING ADULTS; CRIMINALIZATION PRIMARILY HARMS THE VULNERABLE RATHER THAN PROTECTING THEM.
CHILDREN SHOULD BE EDUCATED WITH MORAL VALUES, WHICH CAN INCLUDE RELIGIOUS OR TRADITIONAL ONES CHOSEN BY THEIR PARENTS, PROVIDED THEY ALSO LEARN CRITICAL THINKING AND BASIC LIBERAL PRINCIPLES.
THOSE WITH GREATER ABILITY TO PAY SHOULD NOT RECEIVE BETTER BASIC HEALTHCARE, BUT MARKET ELEMENTS AND OPTIONAL SUPPLEMENTAL CARE CAN IMPROVE OVERALL SYSTEM PERFORMANCE.
A BETTER WORLD WILL COME FROM AUTOMATION, SCIENCE, AND TECHNOLOGY RESPONSIBLY DEVELOPED; THESE ARE THE PRIMARY DRIVERS OF LONG-TERM HUMAN PROGRESS.
GOVERNMENT INTERVENTION OFTEN THREATENS THE ECONOMY THROUGH UNINTENDED CONSEQUENCES, REGULATORY THICKETS, AND POLITICAL FAVORITISM, THOUGH SOME RULES ARE NECESSARY.
EVEN WHEN PROTESTING AN AUTHORITARIAN GOVERNMENT, INITIATING VIOLENCE IS USUALLY COUNTERPRODUCTIVE AND MORALLY DUBIOUS; PEACEFUL RESISTANCE AND INSTITUTIONAL PRESSURE ARE PREFERABLE.
ABORTION SHOULD BE LEGALLY RESTRICTED AFTER MEANINGFUL FETAL DEVELOPMENT WITH EXCEPTIONS FOR LIFE AND HEALTH OF THE MOTHER; IT IS NOT AN ABSOLUTE RIGHT.
A HIERARCHICAL STATE IS INEVITABLE TO SOME DEGREE, BUT IT SHOULD BE MERITOCRATIC, ACCOUNTABLE, AND LIMITED RATHER THAN RIGID OR ARISTOCRATIC.
PUBLICLY-FUNDED RESEARCH IS OFTEN HIGHLY BENEFICIAL, ESPECIALLY BASIC SCIENCE, THOUGH MARKET INCENTIVES AND PRIVATE FUNDING ALSO DRIVE CRUCIAL APPLIED INNOVATION.
NO GROUP'S GOALS SHOULD BE FURTHERED ABOVE ALL OTHERS OR ABOVE UNIVERSAL HUMAN PRINCIPLES; THIS KIND OF PARTICULARISM EASILY JUSTIFIES INJUSTICE.

FROM EACH ACCORDING TO HIS ABILITY, TO EACH ACCORDING TO HIS NEEDS IS A NOBLE ASPIRATION THAT FAILS CATASTROPHICALLY WHEN MADE INTO STATE POLICY DUE TO INCENTIVE DESTRUCTION AND AUTHORITARIAN ENFORCEMENT.
